supplyChain.intro: Orders are loaded at our dock near Hyderabad and dispatched by road to every part of India.

chapters.title: West & South

chapters.title: East & North-East

chapters.title: Delivered

slides.title: KJS India at a glance
slides.summary: Contract food manufacturing from ingredient preparation to packed goods ready for dispatch.

items.title: Processing
items.body: Dry blending distributes ingredients evenly. Ball milling refines chocolate and other confectionery bases.

items.title: Packaging
items.body: The pack format depends on the product and its intended use, from a single portion to an outer shipping case.

items.title: Warehousing
items.body: Ingredients, packaging and finished goods are stored separately, with dedicated staff for dispatch.

slides.title: Packaging formats
slides.summary: Pack format can be tailored to the product and the customer’s specifications.

items.title: Pouches
items.body: Form-fill-seal equipment shapes film into a pouch, fills it and seals it, in vertical and horizontal formats.

items.title: Cartons
items.body: A pouch-in-carton uses an inner pouch. Direct-fill cartons carry the product in the carton itself.

items.title: Outer packaging
items.body: A bag-in-box combines a flexible bag with a rigid box. A master shipper groups packs for dispatch.

slides.title: Quality and testing
slides.summary: Process controls, internal checks and external microbiological testing.

items.title: Process controls
items.body: HACCP plans include screening, magnets and metal detection.

items.title: Internal checks
items.body: Particle size, bulk density, moisture and pH.

items.title: External checks
items.body: External microbiological testing covers pathogens and spoilage organisms.
